schema.description: Response schema for a dashboard session

data.description: This is an object representing a dashboard session in the app.

created_at.description: Time at which the object was created.

idle_timeout_minutes.description: The number of minutes of inactivity before the session requires re-authentication. When both this and the account's idle timeout are set, the stricter (shorter) value applies.

return_url.description: The URL to redirect to when the user signs out of the session.

url.description: The short-lived URL of the dashboard session. When the user visits this URL, their browser will be logged in to the account.

user_id.description: The ID of the user associated with the dashboard session.

data.title: DashboardSession

schema.title: DashboardSessionResponse
